Anna L.: Heads-up — Q2 promo looks like it will shift traffic toward long-context streaming (we sampled traffic and avg seq length jumped ~2.6x). We need a short capacity plan for the 72h burst window.
Josh K.: Can you paste the histogram / rough numbers? streaming vs non-streaming mix changes how we provision. If streaming is dominant we hit KV cache and memory more than raw FLOPS.
Anna L.: Quick stats from the sample: p50=1.2k tokens, p90=7.4k, p99=25k. Rough estimate = +2.3M token-hours over 72h -> ~110 GPU-hours on H100 (fp16) assuming current batching. Tail pushes that up.
Priya R.: 110 GPU-hours is optimistic if the tail keeps sessions open. For latency SLOs we should target 150-200 GPU-hours buffer and prefer using A100 spot capacity for lower-cost, but route the >16k contexts to H100.
Marco T.: Tradeoff note: A100 is cheaper but H100 handles >16k contexts with fewer kernels and lower latency. Mixed pool approach: route sessions >12k tokens to H100 pool, others to A100. Autoscaler needs token-aware binning (by estimated context).
Anna L.: Proposed routing policy: if est_context_tokens > 12k -> route to h100-burst pool (autoscale up to 40 nodes); else route to a100-pool with spot burst. Also set prewarm "warmup_sessions"=100 per node. Does that sound safe?
Josh K.: Two caveats: EU region has peering and quota limits — current h100 reservations = 22 nodes. Cross-region fallback will add ~80-120ms median p99 network penalty. Also egress cost could increase ~+$3.5k for the 72h burst if we spill to us-west.
Priya R.: Cost mitigations: enable aggressive KV prefix reuse; enable temporary 8-bit quantized variants for non-critical customers; schedule batch-only spot nodes for background reranks and async jobs to avoid contention.
infra-bot: deploy_event: autoscaler-policy:update by Marco T. at 1918765600
Anna L.: Can someone run a 95th-percentile session token query so we have a clearer number? Example query I used:
```
SELECT percentile(95, session_total_tokens) FROM sessions WHERE start >= now() - interval '30d'
```
I got p95 = 18k tokens, avg_session_seconds = 320.
Josh K.: I'll run a prewarm stress test tomorrow 09:00 PT. Plan: synthetic sessions of ~18k tokens, 50 concurrent/sec for 10 minutes. Goal: p95 latency < 350ms. I'll post results and flame graphs.
Marco T.: I'll file a temporary quota request with cloud account team and set cross-region fallback to only trigger after local pool usage > 30%. Also lowering autoscale cooldown to 4m to reduce overprovision flapping.
Priya R.: +1. Add tags for billing/cost tracking: promo-q2-longctx, route=h100-mix. Also emit per-model token-hours and per-route egress metrics during the burst.
Anna L.: :thumbsup: Thanks all — plan: (1) Josh runs prewarm test, (2) Marco submits quota, (3) Priya prepares quantized fallback and KV configs. Quick sync 30m after test. cc @eng-sre @oncall
